content:
Apple just rolled out a fresh round of beta software for testing. Beta 8 for systems including iPadOS 27 and tvOS 27 has arrived. Here is what you can expect.

Update (5:04 PM Eastern Time): iPadOS 27 and tvOS 27 are now also available to public beta testers.

Beta 8 for systems including iPadOS 27 has arrived, with the RC version expected to launch next week

Apple's next major software releases are nearing readiness. With today's beta 8, the builds are expected to receive further bug fixes and refinements on the way to general availability.

Beta 8 for systems including iPadOS 27, watchOS 27, tvOS 27, and visionOS 27 has arrived.

These will likely be the final round of betas before the RC versions debut next Wednesday, right after Apple's September keynote.

Beyond performance improvements and under-the-hood fixes, we do not expect any user-facing changes in today's beta.

Apple always holds back some features for its major operating system releases to be revealed with the RC builds.

For example, watchOS 27 may include new health features and watch faces not yet seen in beta, to be announced next week alongside new Watch hardware.

Beyond that, the software available in today's newest beta is very close to the final version that will ship to all users in a few weeks.

How is Apple's beta software running for you? Do you think it is ready to launch? Let us know in the comments.
